text:
maya: Quick sync — partner storefront launch scheduled for Tue 05/28. Need final asset handoff from partners (logos, exact product names, embargo window).

sam: Copy that. Are we still planning joint blog + short press note + landing hero?

maya: yes. Hero, 3 bullets, 2 screenshots, and a partner quote. Partner legal needs to sign off on quote by Mon EOD.

noah: Engineering: are we done with the partner SKU mapping for the checkout flow? Last I saw a mismatch for the GCP SKU.

jin: I fixed the SKU mapping in staging yesterday. Deploy-bot ran canary, no errors. Will run full rollout after final manifest.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment successful — 2 nodes passed smoke tests. Rollout window open Tue 03:00-05:00 UTC.

sam: For press timing, partners requested an embargo lift at 10:00 PT. Elaine, any issues with that window (legal/PR approvals)?

elaine: Need partner clearance on the quote and logo usage. Also confirm export controls for the hardware partner bundle. If partners approve, legal can sign by Mon 11:00 PT.

maya: Partners asked for mention of the SI integration marketplace listing and a co-hosted webinar the following week. Do we want the listing to go live same time as announcement?

sam: Recommend soft-live listing at announcement + full docs published 24 hrs later. Allows press to link while docs sync propagates.

noah: Agree. We'll enable read-only docs at publish, then open edits after 24h. Need a short "what's new" snippet for the hero.

sam: Draft blog outline here: 1) problem, 2) how partner + Redwood solves it, 3) customer quote, 4) CTA to partner storefront + SI enablement kit.

maya: I'll ping partners for quote and logos now. @press-bot can you queue the embargo notice once we get partner ok?

press-bot: Noted. Will queue embargo notice when I receive: partner_ok=true, assets=logos+quote, final_blog_link.

maya: Action items: Maya — collect assets (owner); Sam — draft blog + press note (owner); Noah/Jin — confirm SKU & staging; Elaine — partner legal signoff. Target: Mon EOD for all assets.

sam: I'll put the blog draft in the marketing drive and link here shortly. Preview link: https://drive.redwood.ai/d/partner-storefront-draft

jin: Small checklist I used:
```
- verify SKU mapping
- run canary
- validate feature flags for storefront
```

noah: Also reminder: analytics tag for partner_id must be present or metrics will be split. Jin pls confirm.

jin: Confirmed. partner_id tag added to checkout events in staging.

elaine: Once partners sign, I'll attach the legal approval note here.

maya: Great. If we hit Mon EOD, schedule: Tue 10:00 PT embargo lift, Tue 10:05 publish blog + storefront soft-live, Wed 10:00 docs open edit, Thu 11:00 webinar registration email.

sam: Sounds good. :thumbsup: I'll coordinate with comms for social cadence.

maya: Thanks team — I'll follow up with partners and post updates here.

noah: 👍
